summary: Iteration 2: Tested new feature set — Settings/Customize (exam+year+theme), Statistics tab (streak/consistency/total/bar chart with 7/30 toggle), Journey click-to-add-test modal, new cards (Pomodoro, Sticky Note, YouTube, Daily Agenda), header icons (info/focus/zen/add-card/customize), and card chrome icons (collapse/resize/delete). Backend: 18/18 pytest passing (added 2 new settings tests for theme + cardData blob persistence). Frontend: 100% of new-feature flows pass. Theme (cyberpunk) and exam type (NEET 2027) persist across reload via /api/settings. All previously-broken icons now work. Regression on existing cards (My Tasks add, Quote rotate) also verified.

issues: Still uses browser-native <input type=date> instead of shadcn Calendar/Popover — same note as iteration 1.
Day cells expose data-date but no data-testid — functional, but per data-testid guideline, adding data-testid='journey-day' would improve automated test discoverability.

action_items: Optional: add data-testid='journey-day' to Journey day cells (currently only data-date).
Optional (iter1 carry-over): replace native date input in Test Planner with shadcn Calendar.
Optional: React Router v7 future flag warnings still noisy in console.
critical_code_review_comments: Settings PUT accepts partial fields via model_dump filtering out None — clean approach. cardData is Any-typed so any client blob is stored (fine for MVP; consider size cap if needed).
Journey day-click routes to AddTestModal with pre-filled date — verified test appears both on graph (yellow cell) and Test Planner list.
Theme persistence via document.documentElement data-theme attribute + /api/settings.theme confirmed working across reload.
12 cards each expose card-collapse/resize/delete-btn — .first selector works but if writing per-card tests, consider scoping by card title.
on_event('startup') still deprecated (FastAPI lifespan) — carried over from iter1, not blocking.
No rate-limit / lockout implemented — playbook mentions 5-fail lockout; not enforced. Enhancement, not a regression.
test_credentials: admin@studylocus.com / admin123 (verified). Register new users at @example.com (avoid .test TLD — reserved by pydantic).
seed_data_creation: Test-prefixed tasks/tests created via UI; per-user isolation confirmed in backend tests.
